tests.name: Concurrent frame publication, worker exit and TLS sanitizer regression
tests.evidence: Real pthread writer contention verified rollback, immutable front buffer, final static frame delivery, single retry, invalidation and zero clients. Twenty live-writer child exits verified EOF/status 75/no concurrent destructors. Linux ASan/UBSan and macOS host runs passed. 12 concurrent OpenSSL lifecycle rounds passed without retained sessions.

tests.name: Slow viewer isolation (candidate 54b48e9)
tests.evidence: With low-latency mode enabled, a raw viewer requesting 357504 bytes stopped reading (SO_RCVBUF=1024). Remote socket was closed when drained 1.67 seconds later, after 262800 bytes. Healthy Chrome WSS viewer displayed Calculator 0 to 2 and retained the final static frame; private screenshots inspected.

tests.name: Short-run crash inventory
tests.evidence: Five baseline crash reports remain unchanged after final 26e3094 install, 10 live configuration reloads and 100 WSS connections. The 10:46:48 candidate 54b48e9 SIGSEGV is retained and documented. No recovery event occurred after the final supervisor start; no long-term crash-free claim.

tests.evidence: Final 26e3094: 10 live LowLatencyMode configuration changes, 10/10 automatic WSS reconnection checks passed (six seconds after preference write plus four seconds browser wait). No additional crash report and no recovery event in the final supervisor window.
